'אַל', neither vav-prefixed); the row's parenthetical "twice, including the form with the vav-prefix" is attached to oshb:Eccl.5.1, but the only vav-prefixed instance among the five ('וְאַל') sits at oshb:Eccl.5.5's second occurrence, alongside its own bare first occurrence ('אַל') -- the row's total (5 tokens across 3 verses: oshb:Eccl.5.1, Eccl.5.3, Eccl.5.5) is right, only the prefix's verse-location is wrong.
